item.tib: mkha' 'gro dgongs pa kun 'dus las yon tan thugs rje kun sgrol gyis dbang khrid bdud bzhi kun bcom
item.coloph: ces mkha' 'gro gsang ba ye shes yon tan skye med rol pa'i dbang khrid bdud bzhi kun bcom ('joms) 'di ni/ lung zin mched grogs slob ma bstan sbyin rnams kyi (kyis) rten 'brel phun sum tshogs pa'i bskur ngor/ shar phyogs rnam dag bkod pa'i 'dus sde ngo mtshar nor bu'i gling du/ sdom pa gsum gyi don la gces spras su mdzad pa'i rnal 'byor chen po kun grol grags pa 'ja' tshon snying pos gangs (gang) shar rang grol gyis brtsams pa/ me 'brug hor zla dgu pa'i tshes la dge'o//
